sloka: तस्मिंस्तु पतिते बाले वज्रताडनविह्वले ।चुक्रोधेन्द्राय पवनः प्रजानामहिताय सः ।। ७.३५.४८ ॥
transliteration: tasmiṁstu patite bāle vajratāḍanavihvale ।cukrodhendrāya pavanaḥ prajānāmahitāya saḥ ।। 7.35.48 ॥

translations.english: When the child, distressed by the thunderbolt's strike, fell, the wind god Vayu became angry at Indra, foreseeing harm to all creatures.
